text: 中国央行：2026年8月，同业拆借日均成交3160.6亿元，同比减少24.6%；银行间市场债券回购日均成交6.5万亿元，同比减少14.8%。2026年8月末，同业拆借未到期余额0.9万亿元，银行间市场债券回购未到期余额9.6万亿元。
text_en: PBOC: In August 2026, the average daily turnover of interbank lending was 316.06 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 24.6%; the average daily turnover of bond repurchases in the interbank market was 6.5 trillion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 14.8%. At the end of August 2026, the outstanding balance of interbank lending was 0.9 trillion yuan, and the outstanding balance of bond repurchases in the interbank market was 9.6 trillion yuan.
